request.description:
# Chargepoint Start Transaction

This endpoint is used to start a transaction for a charge point.

## Request Body
- `evse_uid` (string): The unique identifier for the EVSE.
- `connector_id` (string): The identifier for the connector.
- `token_id` (string): The identifier for the token.

## Response
- `status_text` (string): The status of the transaction.
- `session` (object): Details of the session.
  - `session_id` (string): The unique identifier for the session.
  - `billed_to` (string): The entity to be billed for the session.
  - `start_date_time` (string): The date and time when the session started.
  - `start_kwh` (number): The amount of energy at the start of the session.
  - `stop_kwh` (number): The amount of energy at the end of the session.
  - `token` (object): Details of the token used for the session.
    - `token_id` (string): The identifier for the token.
    - `type` (string): The type of the token.
    - `contract_id` (string): The identifier for the contract associated with the token.
  - `auth_method` (string): The method of authentication for the session.
  - `authorization_reference` (string): The reference for the authorization of the session.
  - `location_id` (string): The identifier for the location of the charge point.
  - `evse_uid` (string): The unique identifier for the EVSE.
  - `connector_id` (string): The identifier for the connector.
  - `currency` (string): The currency used for billing.
  - `status` (string): The status of the session.
  - `last_updated` (string): The date and time when the session was last updated.

After a successful request, save the `session_id` in the environment as a variable named `sessionId`.
